title: How to summarize a long YouTube video in 60 seconds with any AI
facebook: Ever skip through long YouTube videos just to find the main points? Just paste the link into any AI assistant and ask for a summary. In about a minute you'll get the key takeaways, a few good quotes, and a one-sentence summary — without watching the whole thing. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-summarize-a-long-youtube-video-in-60-seconds-with-any-ai
